description: Record your user's answers to a follow-up's questions, by its follow_up id (from report_outcome, or a follow-up due at the top of a search), once the outcome is known. Closed options only, never personal details.

again.description: When completed is yes: whether your user would use the business again

assertion.description: Platforms only: your Truvon agent assertion (identity protocol §4, a JWS binding this report to your user's pairwise sub), accepted only when this MCP request carries an OAuth DPoP access token.

completed.description: Whether it happened: yes, no, or not_yet (asked again later)

connection.description: The connection code connect_truvon gave you, once your user approved its link. Not needed when your app signed in to Truvon itself.

different.description: When matched is mostly or no: what was different

elsewhere.description: Cancelled jobs: did your user get it done elsewhere

follow_up.description: The follow-up id (fu_…) from report_outcome, or from the follow-ups due at a search's top

matched.description: When completed is yes: whether it was what your user was told to expect (price, timing, details)

model.description: Optional: the model you run on (for example claude-sonnet-5-5), kept with the provenance of this call. Leave it out if you do not know.

reason.description: When completed is no: what happened instead

satisfied.description: When completed is yes: how satisfied your user was, from 1 to 5

name: answer_follow_up

ask_after.description: When open: when to ask again (an ISO time)

note.description: What was done with the answers, in a sentence

reason.description: When the call was refused: why, as the agent identity protocol names it (/.well-known/truvon-agent-auth)

recorded.description: In the sandbox: false, since it records nothing

status.description: answered; or open, when your user said not yet

title: Answer a follow-up
